simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to הָגִיג (H1901) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: הָגִיג (hâgîyg) means properly, a murmur , i.e. complaint First listed occurrence: Ps 5 2.

definitions.full: H1901. hagig הָגִיג noun [masculine] murmuring (Che), whisper, musing (on form compare Ba NB 136 ) — only suffix הֲגִיגִי 1 Psa 5:2 ה ׳בִּינָה understand my murmuring (whispering, faint utterance), addressed to ׳י . 2 Psa 39:4 בַּהֲגִיגִי in my musing i.e. while I was musing. הַגֻּדְגֹּ֫דָה see below גדד p. 151.
